rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a wealthy and powerful business person.

example.english: This property tycoon is very influential in the business world.
example.traditional: 呢位地產大亨喺商界好有影響力。
example.jyutping: ne1 wai6 dei6 caan2 daai6 hang1 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 hou2 jau5 jing2 hoeng2 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the person's great wealth is more prominent than their business influence.

example.english: That tycoon donated a lot of money to charity.
example.traditional: 嗰位富豪捐咗好多錢畀慈善機構。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 fu3 hou4 gyun1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin4 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a powerful leading figure in the business world.

example.english: When that business tycoon speaks, the whole meeting room falls silent.
example.traditional: 嗰位商界巨頭一開口，成個會議室都靜晒。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 soeng1 gaai3 geoi6 tau4 jat1 hoi1 hau2 seng4 go3 wui6 ji5 sat1 dou1 zing6 saai3
